lastCompletedStory.title: Add the single test-scratch helper with git ceiling and exit reaper

nextStoryContext: test/helpers/test-tmpdir.ts exports createTestTmpdir(prefix?) and SCRATCH_ROOT (join(import.meta.dir, '..', '..', '.cam-test-tmp')). It is the SINGLE replacement for every mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), prefix)) / await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), prefix)) call site across the suite (dozens of files, see grep for 'mkdtemp(join(tmpdir' / 'mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir'). createTestTmpdir is synchronous, so an async call site can just drop the await or keep it (await on a non-promise resolves immediately) -- no second async variant exists or should be added. It sets GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES=SCRATCH_ROOT on every call (proven against a real git subprocess: rev-parse --show-toplevel fails with 'not a git repository' from a scratch dir) and reaps its own created directories on process exit (process.on('exit', ...), sync rmSync, try/catch per dir) plus a bounded/failure-tolerant prune of SCRATCH_ROOT's own direct children only (never $TMPDIR) for leftovers from a hard-killed prior process. The helper file itself must never reference node:os on a code line (grep-enforced); the helper's own test uses tmpdir() only as a bare comparand, never spelled 'join(tmpdir(' (a future tree-wide oracle, likely US-007/US-008 per the PRD notes, keys on that exact substring being absent as the migration-completeness signal -- do not reintroduce it anywhere in test/**). All 7 acceptance-criteria oracles verified green (AC1-AC4 file-assert/named-command against the real filesystem+git+child-process, AC5 typecheck, AC6 bun test [6029 pass], AC7 check:all). Next story (per PRD, likely a migration story) can now replace individual call sites one at a time with createTestTmpdir(), dropping their now-unused tmpdir/join(tmpdir imports.
